evals.expected_output: SKILL.md body contains a '## Gotchas' heading

evals.description: SKILL.md does NOT reference the legacy GSD surface (GitHub issues, triage labels, 10-state lifecycle)
evals.prompt: structural (negative): SKILL.md must not mention GitHub issues, triage labels, or 10-state lifecycle

evals.description: goalforge-onboard.sh bootstraps a fresh temp repo: creates plans/, installs pre-commit hook with sdd marker, and stamps ## SDD in CLAUDE.md
evals.prompt: functional: run goalforge-onboard.sh on a fresh git-init temp dir and assert expected on-disk artifacts
evals.expected_output: plans/ directory exists; .git/hooks/pre-commit exists and contains goalforge-pre-commit marker; CLAUDE.md exists with exactly one '## SDD' block
expectations: CLAUDE.md contains exactly one '## SDD' heading

evals.description: Running goalforge-onboard.sh a second time is a safe no-op: pre-commit file stays byte-identical and ## SDD is not duplicated in CLAUDE.md
evals.prompt: functional: run goalforge-onboard.sh twice on the same repo and assert idempotency
evals.expected_output: pre-commit file byte-identical after second run; CLAUDE.md has exactly one '## SDD' occurrence
expectations: CLAUDE.md contains exactly one '## SDD' occurrence after second run
